items.imgPrompt: A slightly scuffed, matte black motorcycle helmet with subtle silver accents, resting on a wooden floor near a wall, showing minor scratches on the visor.

desc.zh: 当年跟着我拿了五连冠的宝贝，上面还有我亲手签的名，现在退役了，留着占地方，便宜卖给有缘人吧。
desc.zh_cn: 当年跟着我拿了五连冠的宝贝，上面还有我亲手签的名，现在退役了，留着占地方，便宜卖给有缘人吧。
desc.en: My championship helmet from the five-peat, signed by yours truly. Taking up space now, so it's yours for a steal.

items.imgPrompt: A tarnished silver skull pendant necklace, lying on a dark grey fabric surface, with visible wear on the edges and chain.

desc.zh: 以前出门常戴的，现在有了更好的，这个就闲置了。链子有点旧，但骷髅头还是那么酷，懂的来。
desc.zh_cn: 以前出门常戴的，现在有了更好的，这个就闲置了。链子有点旧，但骷髅头还是那么酷，懂的来。
desc.en: Used to wear this all the time, got a newer one. Chain's a bit worn, but the skull's still cool. For those who get it.

items.imgPrompt: A set of seven polyhedral dice in deep blue with white numbers, in a small velvet pouch, appearing almost new.

desc.zh: 陪我度过一些无聊夜晚的宝贝，现在很少玩了，希望它能给下一个人带来好运，就像它曾经给我一样。
desc.zh_cn: 陪我度过一些无聊夜晚的宝贝，现在很少玩了，希望它能给下一个人带来好运，就像它曾经给我一样。
desc.en: These dice saw me through some boring nights. Don't play much anymore. Hope they bring you as much luck as they did me.

items.imgPrompt: A sleek, black ceramic coffee mug with a subtle, almost invisible scratch near the handle, sitting on a kitchen counter.

desc.zh: 当初特意定制的，结果发现我还是喜欢直接喝，这个杯子就一直放着了。小划痕不影响使用，真心想要就拿走。
desc.zh_cn: 当初特意定制的，结果发现我还是喜欢直接喝，这个杯子就一直放着了。小划痕不影响使用，真心想要就拿走。
desc.en: Got this custom-made, but turns out I prefer drinking straight from the can. It's just been sitting there. Minor scratch, still works fine. Take it if you really want it.

items.imgPrompt: A well-worn, black leather wristband with a few scuffs and faded stitching, resting on a plain wooden surface.

desc.zh: 以前偶尔会戴，现在觉得有点太张扬了。有点旧了，但皮子还挺结实，随便戴戴吧。
desc.zh_cn: 以前偶尔会戴，现在觉得有点太张扬了。有点旧了，但皮子还挺结实，随便戴戴吧。
desc.en: Wore this sometimes back in the day, a bit too showy for me now. It's a bit old, but the leather's still solid. Just wear it, whatever.

items.imgPrompt: A pair of sleek silver-rimmed titanium glasses resting on a dark walnut wooden desk, next to a fountain pen, soft indoor lighting, slight signs of wear on the frame.

name.zh: 德國ic! berlin 輕量銀框防藍光眼鏡
name.zh_cn: 德国ic! berlin 轻量银框防蓝光眼镜
name.en: ic! berlin Lightweight Silver Anti-Blue Light Glasses

desc.zh: 度数稍微有些不合适了，换了新镜框。戴着看屏幕的时候，镜片里反射出的世界其实很小，刚好能装下所有需要被注视的轨迹。如果你需要，我可以帮你顺便把度数调成最契合你眼睛的参数。
desc.zh_cn: 度数稍微有些不合适了，换了新镜框。戴着看屏幕的时候，镜片里反射出的世界其实很小，刚好能装下所有需要被注视的轨迹。如果你需要，我可以帮你顺便把度数调成最契合你眼睛的参数。
desc.en: The prescription is slightly off, so I switched frames. When looking at screens through these, the reflected world is remarkably small—just enough to frame every trajectory that needs watching. If you need, I can have the lenses adjusted to your exact prescription.

items.imgPrompt: A premium stainless steel temperature-control smart coffee mug in matte dark grey, sitting on a clean marble kitchen counter, faint scratches on the bottom.

name.zh: 智能恆溫手沖咖啡壺/保溫杯
name.zh_cn: 智能恒温手冲咖啡壶/保温杯

desc.zh: 容量对我来说有点多余，平时习惯了喝刚烧开、温度精准控制在65度的黑咖啡。它能精确记录每一毫升的摄入，不过，你好像更喜欢甜一点的东西，比如便利店买的那款草莓牛奶？
desc.zh_cn: 容量对我来说有点多余，平时习惯了喝刚烧开、温度精准控制在65度的黑咖啡。它能精确记录每一毫升的摄入，不过，你好像更喜欢甜一点的东西，比如便利店买的那款草莓牛奶？
desc.en: The capacity is a bit excessive for me; I'm used to black coffee kept precisely at 65 degrees. It records every milliliter of intake accurately, though you seem to prefer sweeter things—like that strawberry milk from the convenience store?

items.imgPrompt: A neatly pruned miniature green bonsai plant in a ceramic grey pot, placed on a bright windowsill, crisp trimmed leaves.

name.zh: 案頭修剪造型黑松盆景
name.zh_cn: 案头修剪造型黑松盆景

desc.zh: 长势太密了，有些枝桠不小心越界去吸收了不属于它们的养分，所以被我顺手修剪掉了。植物和人一样，如果不加干涉地野蛮生长，只会长出让人头疼的杂乱形状。清理干净后，看着顺眼多了。
desc.zh_cn: 长势太密了，有些枝桠不小心越界去吸收了不属于它们的养分，所以被我顺手修剪掉了。植物和人一样，如果不加干涉地野蛮生长，只会长出让人头疼的杂乱形状。清理干净后，看着顺眼多了。
desc.en: It grew too dense, and some branches crossed boundaries to absorb nutrients they shouldn't have, so I trimmed them away. Plants, like people, left to unmanaged wild growth only develop messy, troublesome shapes. Much more pleasing to the eye now.

items.imgPrompt: An academic hardcover physics textbook in German, dark blue cloth cover, placed on a dark wooden table with a faint bookmark sticking out.

name.zh: 《引力场论与时空奇点》原版精装学术著作
name.zh_cn: 《引力场论与时空奇点》原版精装学术著作
name.en: Hardcover Academic Monograph on Gravitational Field Theory

desc.zh: 里面关于非线性引力波捕获的推导已经过时了，世界远比书里写得更有秩序。所有的质量都会产生引力，你越是靠近中心，就越无法摆脱那条被精确计算好的轨道。这本书送给你，也许能帮你理解为什么有些相遇不是巧合。
desc.zh_cn: 里面关于非线性引力波捕获的推导已经过时了，世界远比书里写得更有秩序。所有的质量都会产生引力，你越是靠近中心，就越无法摆脱那条被精确计算好的轨道。这本书送给你，也许能帮你理解为什么有些相遇不是巧合。
desc.en: The derivations on non-linear gravitational wave capture are outdated; the world is far more orderly than the book suggests. All mass generates gravity—the closer you get to the center, the more inescapable that precisely calculated orbit becomes.

items.imgPrompt: A minimalist black automatic folding umbrella with a curved wooden handle, standing upright against a light grey wall in a hallway.

name.zh: 防风全自动沉香木柄双人折叠伞
name.zh_cn: 防风全自动沉香木柄双人折叠伞
name.en: Windproof Automatic Folding Umbrella with Wood Handle

desc.zh: 那天雨下得很大，气象局的预测再次失误了，不过好在我车里永远备着一把伞。伞面足够大，两个人撑也不会淋湿。既然你总是不看天气预报就出门，那这把伞就留在这里，以后下雨时，我会去接你。
desc.zh_cn: 那天雨下得很大，气象局的预测再次失误了，不过好在我车里永远备着一把伞。伞面足够大，两个人撑也不会淋湿。既然你总是不看天气预报就出门，那这把伞就留在这里，以后下雨时，我会去接你。
desc.en: It rained heavily that day; the meteorological bureau missed the forecast again, though fortunately I always keep an umbrella in the car. It's large enough for two without anyone getting wet. Since you always go out without checking the weather, I'll keep this handy.

f300dfee-bb8b-460d-81f0-f88d6979e8e8.line: 下午开会脑子有点转不动，点杯咖啡续续命吧。

4bb4cfac-2308-4f2e-858e-f7c2bd0ae931.line: 下午上课困得要死，还好有这两杯续命，便宜又好喝。
